messages:
alex: Follow-up to the offload/fragmentation RFC: proposing an ephemeral pinned-window primitive. idea: grant requests a tiny, timeboxed residency region on the GPU (e.g., M pages for T ms) that is cheap to acquire and cheap to revoke. goal: reduce large fetch spikes for streaming tails without doing heavyweight compaction. looking for tradeoffs + what to watch for.

morgan: Quick clarifying q: is this orthogonal to prefetch? sounds like prefetch is speculative, this is on-demand and guaranteed for a short window. also how do we avoid scattering many tiny pinned regions?

li: Implementation sketch: allocator returns a lease token referencing a contiguous slab-aligned region. runtime atomically pins that region and tags the request with the token. on pressure allocator issues revoke notice; runtime checks token at next safe point (e.g., next token-gen) and either demotes pages back to host or performs an inline tiny fetch. Important: must update pinned_page_census before/after to avoid double-free races.

henry: Fragmentation concerns: lots of M-sized windows can leave holes. mitigations: enforce slab alignment (4KiB or larger), maintain a short LRU of freed window chunks for reuse, and coalescing when adjacent freed windows exist. add per-tenant soft quotas for pinned pages so one noisy tenant can't exhaust the pool.

morgan: NUMA and copy-cost note: prefer local-host pages if possible. if lease maps to remote node pages, charge a cross-node penalty metric and prefer smaller windows. expose numa_hint in endpoint config.

alex: sample endpoint config we can surface: 

"micro_pin_pages": "48",
"micro_pin_ms": "120",
"preempt_strategy": "notify_async",
"numa_hint": "local_prefer",
"tenant_pin_quota": "256"

also: telemetry we need to capture: pin_grants, pin_revokes, avg_pin_hold_ms, p99_gen_latency_with_pin, pinned_pages_by_tenant, cross_numa_pin_pct, pin_coalesce_hits.

perf-bot: perf summary for branch micro-pin/basic: p99 reduced ~3.1% on mixed trace. stress-run reported a race in revoke path causing pinned_count mismatch. logs: https://ci.fake/reports/micro-pin/77 (short)

li: we'll add an atomic refcount update and targeted unit test. also need a deterministic recreate harness for interleaved grant+revoke to catch races.

henry: rollout plan: feature-flag behind "micro_pin". stage: grant-only mode to collect metrics; then enable revoke-path. Canary on dedicated pool with quota enforcement. If we see high revoke_rate for a tenant, fallback actions: (1) deny further pins, (2) suggest model-variant fallback (reduced kv size / quantized weights).

morgan: add a safety for long-held pins: if hold > 2x configured window, forcibly log and scrub. the allocator should also periodically compact free windows during low load.

alex: volunteers? morgan -> coalesce + quota accounting. li -> allocator token + revoke test. henry -> rollout + model-fallback hook + dashboard alerts. I'll write the RFC follow-up and include sequence diagrams and perf plots from the replay harness.

perf-bot: noted test fix queued; re-run scheduled.
